card.name: Bambuco
card.tagline: Andean Colombia's courtly string-led national air.
card.profile: A couples courtship dance-song of the Colombian Andes (Huila, Tolima, Cundinamarca), in 6/8-3/4 sesquialtera, performed by string ensembles of tiple, bandola and guitar (Britannica; Colombia Country Brand). Dancers perform gentle, waltz-like flirtation using a handkerchief (raboegallo), with brief delicate contact. Celebrated at the Festival Folclorico y Reinado Nacional del Bambuco in Neiva (Britannica).
card.insight: Long described as Colombia's 'national air,' the bambuco genre has no standalone national-heritage statute; Ley 1026 of 2006 instead declared the Neiva festival cultural heritage of the nation (Ley 1026 de 2006, SUIN-Juriscol).
